name: EMA33 Crossover Ladder Gold m1
description: A momentum entry strategy on XAUUSD m1 bars. A long is triggered when the signal candle opens below EMA(33) and closes above it, confirming the 3 prior candles had their entire range (high and low) below the EMA, and the signal candle's range is within a tunable ATR multiple to avoid chasing extended moves. The stop-loss is the signal candle's open. The position is scaled out in a doubling ladder: 50% is closed at 2R, then the stop moves to 2R and target becomes 4R; at 4R another 50% of the remainder is closed, stop moves to 4R, target becomes 8R, and so on. Sized by fixed risk percent of equity.
buy_condition: 1) EMA(ema_period) is computed on close. 2) Signal candle: open < EMA and close > EMA. 3) For each of the 3 candles immediately before the signal candle: high < EMA and low < EMA (entire candle below EMA). 4) Signal candle range (high − low) < atr_filter_mult × ATR(atr_period). Entry is a market order filled at the NEXT bar open.
sell_condition: Position is exited in a scaling ladder: at each 2^n × R level (2R, 4R, 8R, …), close 50% of the remaining position and move the stop-loss up to that level. The trade fully closes when the stop is hit at any rung of the ladder or when equity/session rules require a flat book.
tp_sl_strategy: Initial SL = open price of the signal candle. R = entry_price − SL. Ladder: (1) First target = entry + 2R → close 50% of position, move SL to entry + 2R, set next TP = entry + 4R. (2) Second target = entry + 4R → close 50% of remainder, move SL to entry + 4R, set next TP = entry + 8R. (3) Pattern continues doubling TP and moving SL to prior TP at each rung. Remainder is stopped out if price retraces to the current SL level.
risk_management: Risk percent sizing: lots = (equity × risk_pct / 100) / (|entry − SL| × 100). Leverage capped at max_leverage. Minimum lot step 0.01. Only one position open at a time; no new entry while a trade is active.

parameters.name: ema_period
parameters.help: Period for the EMA used in the crossover condition.

parameters.name: atr_period
parameters.help: Period for the ATR used in the candle-size filter.

parameters.name: atr_filter_mult
parameters.help: Signal candle range must be less than this multiple of ATR to allow entry.

parameters.name: lookback_candles
parameters.help: Number of candles before the signal candle that must have their entire range below the EMA.

parameters.name: risk_pct
parameters.help: Percentage of account equity risked per trade.

parameters.name: max_leverage
parameters.help: Maximum leverage cap on notional position size.

parameters.name: ladder_start_r
parameters.help: First take-profit level expressed as a multiple of R (subsequent levels double each time).

parameters.name: ladder_close_fraction
parameters.help: Fraction of the remaining position closed at each ladder TP level.

notes: 1) Entries are market orders at the next bar open after the signal bar; there will be slippage vs. the exact EMA cross price. 2) Because entry price differs from signal candle close, R is computed using actual fill price minus signal candle open (SL). 3) The doubling ladder means the final rung can never be fully closed by TP — the last remnant exits on the trailing stop. 4) Strategy is long-only; no short mirror is defined. 5) Only m1 data is used; no higher-timeframe filter.
